help.short: The name of the configuration store.
Identifier of key and label combination. Key and label are joined by $ character. Label is optional.

description: Get the properties of the specified key-value. NOTE: This operation is intended for use in ARM Template deployments. For all other scenarios involving App Configuration key-values the data plane API should be used instead.

operations.description: Gets the properties of the specified key-value. NOTE: This operation is intended for use in ARM Template deployments. For all other scenarios involving App Configuration key-values the data plane API should be used instead.

params.description: The name of the configuration store.
params.name: configStoreName

params.description: Identifier of key and label combination. Key and label are joined by $ character. Label is optional.
params.name: keyValueName

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. E.g. "/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}"
props.name: id

props.description:
The content type of the key-value's value.
Providing a proper content-type can enable transformations of values when they are retrieved by applications.
props.name: contentType

props.description: An ETag indicating the state of a key-value within a configuration store.
props.name: eTag

props.description:
The primary identifier of a key-value.
The key is used in unison with the label to uniquely identify a key-value.
props.name: key

props.description:
A value used to group key-values.
The label is used in unison with the key to uniquely identify a key-value.
props.name: label

props.description: The last time a modifying operation was performed on the given key-value.
props.name: lastModified

props.description:
A value indicating whether the key-value is locked.
A locked key-value may not be modified until it is unlocked.
props.name: locked

props.description: A dictionary of tags that can help identify what a key-value may be applicable for.
props.name: tags

props.description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.
props.name: systemData

props.description: The identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdBy

props.description: The type of identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdByType

props.description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)
props.name: lastModifiedAt

props.description: The identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedBy

props.description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedByType

props.description: The type of the resource. E.g. "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines" or "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts"
props.name: type
